purpose: Test whether preserving the V83 terminal-OCS initializer and admitting only structurally latency-reducing nonterminal idle-warm substitutions under whole-window FaaSRank, OCS and paper-welfare certificates can recover V83 throughput while closing its QPR gap.

diagnosis_frozen_before_implementation.root_cause_hypothesis: V84 made local OCS substitutions for 45.58% of assigned players, but its dual certificate protected only the later Nash proposal relative to that already-hybrid initializer. The broad initializer therefore increased latency and cost and reduced throughput before the guard acted. V83 was materially stronger, so V85 must preserve V83 as an explicit initializer anchor and permit only strict structural idle-warm dominance that survives complete-window certificates.
diagnosis_frozen_before_implementation.first_principles_latency_mechanism: An idle-warm container can execute without cold-start or busy-container delay. Replacing a non-idle-warm faithful choice with an idle-warm OCS choice directly improves a simulator state available before placement; it is not inferred from completed-request outcomes.

scientific_boundary.E620_E629_disposition: V84 result-blind failure evidence; retained, V84 family closed, aggregate diagnosis only

candidate.player_frontier: PreAllDone: every parent of a scheduled function has completed
candidate.anchor_initializer: Reproduce V83 exactly: terminal functions use the exact frozen OCS current-demand best node; nonterminal functions use frozen faithful FaaSRank epsilon-greedy selection and actual-selection rolling history.
candidate.alternative_initializer: Rebuild the same player order from the same pre-placement aggregates and history. Terminal choices remain identical to the anchor. A nonterminal OCS node may replace the faithful node only when the OCS node is idle-warm for that function, the faithful node is not idle-warm, and the OCS node's current FaaSRank score plus implementation EPSILON is nonworse than the faithful node's score.
candidate.initializer_atomic_gate: Select the complete alternative only when it contains at least one structural substitution, its V83 routed sequential score is nonworse than the anchor, its exact OCS sequential score strictly improves over the anchor, and paper social welfare at immutable baseline prices is nonworse. Otherwise restore the exact V83 anchor assignment and history.
candidate.coordination: The unchanged paper-utility best response produces a proposal. Accept it only when immutable-baseline paper social welfare strictly improves and both complete V83-routed and exact OCS sequential scores are nonworse than the selected initializer; otherwise restore the selected initializer and baseline signal.
candidate.history_rule: Commit only the actual selected complete initializer's sequential history; rejected alternatives cannot affect later windows.

implementation_tests_required_before_bui: the V85 profile round-trips and retains the parent-complete frontier, native player order and policy-independent reference key
the anchor initializer exactly reproduces V83 terminal-OCS plus nonterminal faithful FaaSRank on a controlled fixture
a nonterminal OCS choice is proposed only for strict idle-warm dominance with a nonworse FaaSRank score
the alternative rejects OCS when it is not idle-warm, when the faithful choice is already idle-warm, or when its FaaSRank score is worse
the complete alternative is rejected independently when routed score, OCS score or immutable-baseline welfare fails its frozen gate
a rejected alternative restores the exact anchor assignment, baseline signal and actual-selection history
the Nash proposal requires strict paper-welfare improvement and nonworse complete routed and OCS scores
all previously registered profiles and all sche_nash tests remain unchanged

execution_order: Commit this V85 plan before modifying scheduler code or generating any E650-E679 artifact.
Implement only the V85 profile and required observability; do not change baselines, paper utility, reference search, common HPA, workload or environment weights.

Pass focused anchor, structural-substitution, initializer-gate and coordination-gate tests plus all sche_nash tests, rustfmt, cargo check and an isolated release build; freeze source commit and binary hash before input generation.
Generate only E650-E659 candidate-only screen inputs, capture each base tape once, derive one scale5 tape per seed and build ten state-matched references.
Execute exactly ten candidate runs strictly serially without opening intermediate QC or performance output.
Require ten attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact frozen runtime identity and a result-free audit before simultaneous reveal.
Require all three candidate arithmetic means to strictly exceed their frozen quality floors; report one-sample BCa intervals without changing the screen gate.
If and only if all three screen gates pass, commit an unchanged-candidate confirmation authorization before generating E660-E679.

Run only twenty unchanged NSESche confirmation samples, not baselines. Require all three confirmation means and all three one-sample BCa lower bounds to exceed the same frozen quality floors before freezing the 100-node point.
If any screen or confirmation gate fails, retain all artifacts, do not tune on those seeds and close the V85 family.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across the complete candidate cohort.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run fixed-window throughput divided by drained-cohort mean latency and cost across finite positive-completion runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same per-run QPR with undefined or zero-completion runs assigned zero over all seeds.
analysis.screen_gate: The candidate must strictly exceed all three frozen quality floors; ties fail.
analysis.screen_uncertainty: Report candidate-minus-fixed-floor one-sample BCa 95% intervals without changing the arithmetic-mean screen gate.
analysis.confirmation_gate: For all three metrics, both the E660-E679 arithmetic mean and the one-sample candidate-minus-fixed-floor BCa 95% lower bound must be strictly greater than the frozen floor/zero; ties fail.
analysis.publication_use: A confirmed result becomes the NSESche homogeneous 100-node low-load scale5 resource-scaling point. It is combined with an already frozen compatible 20-node NSESche point; no 100-node baseline curve is required.
analysis.failure_action: Retain every artifact, do not tune on revealed seeds, generate no reserved inputs after a screen failure and close V85.
